description: The payout ledger for Levanta creator commerce: unpaid invoices, link earnings, and seller creator ROI from a local store.

novel_features.name: Unpaid payouts
novel_features.description: List synced invoice items that are still pending or late.

novel_features.name: Earnings reconcile
novel_features.description: Flag invoice items whose commission or paid status disagrees with stored report rows.

novel_features.name: Links that earned
novel_features.description: Roll creator report rows up to one line per link that earned commission.

novel_features.name: Payout gap
novel_features.description: Show brand-months where reports earned commission and no invoice item exists.

novel_features.name: Links that stopped earning
novel_features.description: List active links that earned commission in the previous window and earn nothing now.

novel_features.name: Creator ROI
novel_features.description: Rank seller creators by commission-to-sales and by the change versus the previous window.
